history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark, messy hair and white earbuds is taking a selfie in a bathroom mirror. He is wearing a plain black t-shirt. The background of the bathroom is visible in the reflection. There's a large mirror taking up most of the frame, with a decorative metal grate pattern above it. Fluorescent lights are mounted on the ceiling, casting a bright, somewhat harsh light. The walls are tiled with a grey, rectangular pattern, and a distinctive black and white geometric pattern adorns the lower part of the wall to the right. The overall mood is casual and modern, with a slightly utilitarian feel due to the bathroom setting. The lighting creates strong reflections and highlights on the mirror's surface.
